sectionUpdates.notes: Necessary supplementary contemplation correction corresponding to acyutāṅke/lap. Keep action, source English and audio fields unchanged.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: Booklet prints only the tāmbūla/blue-flower meditation in its Śrī-labelled section, while audio distinctly recites Lakṣmī two-lotus verse and Bhū betel/blue-flower verse.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Retain both recorded deity sections and their respective objects; never replace one with the other or relabel Bhū as Lakṣmī.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF śyāmāṅkakāntisahitām vs recorded śyāmāṅgakānti sahitāṁ; PDF flags its own compound as unusual.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Retain audio-supported śyāmāṅga, dark bodily radiance; insufficient basis for silent k/g replacement.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF suśūla and unrepeated cakrābja vs recording triśūla and repeated cakrābja.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Keep recorded triśūla and both repetitions; only recover noisy tarjana from the supported phonetic segment.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF nutinutyavacaḥpravṛttim is itself explicitly uncertain; recording reads nutinityavacaḥ. PDF has only one prāṇa invocation without all the recorded repeated forms.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Keep recorded phrase and all repeated prāṁ/Mukhyaprāṇa/dhyāyāmi/āvāhayāmi forms; do not normalize uncertain printing or drop repetitions.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF udyaddivākara-samūhanibhām vs recorded restarted udayad udyad divākara sannibhāṁ.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Retain actual restarted opening; do not insert booklet-only samūha.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF ātmasaṁsthām vs strong repeated recording smaratātmavidyāṁ; PDF explicitly acknowledges Tantrasārasaṅgraha ātmavidyām parallel.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Preserve ātmavidyāṁ and both actual occurrences. No source text, line count or blank separators changed.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF omits recorded Gaurī Vedic verse, attendant deity salutations, repetitions and additional formulas.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Keep all actually recorded material; PDF scope does not authorize deletions.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF sacchāstra vs recorded śāstra; prāṇarekhā vs recorded prāṇaśrī rekhāyāṁ; sarvadevābhimāni vs recorded sarvavedābhimāni vedābhimāni.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Do not add sat, delete śrī, collapse repetition, or change Veda to deva without stronger acoustic evidence. Meanings identify technical Prāṇa-line context and preserve explicit uncertainty.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF hrīṁ māyā, kṛtī/śāntī, varuṇānīṁ, etān vyāsaśiṣyān and kartṝn vs recorded śrīmāyā, kṛti/śānti, vāruṇīś, etān and kṛtān.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Preserve the audible list, vowel spellings, endings and shortened forms. No added Vyāsaśiṣyān phrase or rewritten author ending.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF kṛpayā saṁmukhībhavantu bhavantaḥ vs recorded kṛpayā sumukhī bhavatv iti prārthya puṣpāñjaliṁ samarpya.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Keep the recorded prayer/instruction syntax; do not import a different address from the booklet.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: Booklet warns that gṛhān evai nānā is printed unevenly; recording baseline gṛhān evainān ājigamiṣati has additional pronoun and coherent close phonetics. Recording also continues with sovereignty/address lines omitted from PDF.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Do not replace coherent recorded words with admitted printing noise or delete the spoken continuation. Keep both the passage-label function and the primary hymn-as-homes/foundation metaphor in the meaning.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF adya, bho svāmin, and simpler bimbe sannihito vs recording yad yad, gosvāmin sarvajagatāṁ and bimbe asmin pustake asmin.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Preserve actual restart and book-location correction. Both acoustic passes and native caption give gosvāmin; do not introduce booklet-only bho or erase the additional location words.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF supratiṣṭhitam astu and two prasīda occurrences vs recorded eight-syllable mantra and richer formula sequence ending three prasīda occurrences.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: No text replacement: preserve actual recorded Oṁ placement, formulas and all three prasīda utterances.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF dedication is a shorter alternate formula; recording has Aṣṭamī intention and longer first-day completion with source-specific indwelling expressions and interruptions.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: Only lexical compound/meaning clarifications proposed. Keep all recorded Sanskrit, repeats, water instruction placement and timing; do not copy booklet dedication wholesale.

rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.difference: PDF does not print the full guru hymns, Puruṣasūkta offering series, 16-upacāra verses, name/anga lists, food/fruit verses or final household prayers found in the recorded Pūjā.
rejectedOrPreservedDifferences.decision: These are unmatched, not disproved. Preserve every recorded line and meaning; do not claim the reference independently validates or corrects their unresolved words.
